forecast_stages.T1: Hypothesized targeted response to misuse, privacy/identity, safety guardrail modifications, rights/opt-out. Dataset rights incidents are tracked as a distinct pathway, not proof of dangerous model capability.
forecast_stages.T2: Hypothesized subsequent provider or regulatory measures affecting higher-capability models and synthetic-media systems, medical/science and physical agents. Disclosure/sectoral rules are not weight bans.
forecast_stages.T3: Hypothesized broad contraction of publicly downloadable models, basic weights, codecs, tokenizers, data and evaluation materials.

priority_bands.P0: Immediate high-evidence rights/provenance triage: T1 with observed gate/unique source or independently governed dataset; T2/T3 gated indispensable dependency; rights-only if HOLD.
priority_bands.P1: Independent non-reconstructible model, specialist dataset, small architecture diversity or essential pipeline dependency across ANY scenario stage; license and source verification only, not priority download.
priority_bands.P2: Distinct but less urgent comparison/reference models and parameter-census research. Any unknown total parameters blocks acquisition preparation.
priority_bands.P3: Evidence-light or overlapping general distribution, high upstream repository cost, and deferred archive value; not a statement of permanent availability.
priority_bands.PX: Hard excluded total>=150B model; retain only historical catalog and do not obtain weights.

framework.strategy_change: No sequential-ban certainty; current events can follow independent DATA_RIGHTS, LICENSE, HOST_POLICY, IDENTITY_SAFETY and CAPABILITY pathways, including out-of-order or no-wave cases.
framework.weights: No model-specific legal-ban probabilities. Deterministic ordinal P0/P1/P2/P3/PX based on hypothesis T1/T2/T3, observed gating, documented provenance and catalog uniqueness, with 150B exclusion, selection, rights and physical storage as independent gates. Not a claim about safety of any model.
